content: Kaudhania to Pekangkiloana Eona Saputuu
Musa aromusaka bhari-bharia jamaʼana miana Israel tee apogau i manga incia, "Siimo manga giu iparintaakana KAWASANA OPU mamudhaakana atopewau.

Nama eo kangengena karajaa amembali upewaua, maka i eo pitu eona satotuuna o eo momangkilo to ingkomiu, siitumo eona Saputuu, eo uponiunto saeoa ihususuaka to KAWASANA OPU. Incema uka mokarajaana i eo incia sumai incia tabeana ahukumu matea.
Bholi upakata waa i saangua tampana mbooresamiu i eona Saputuu."
Pasombaa Hususu to Pakaroana Kema Momangkilo tee Ibaadati i Nuncana
Musa apogau i bhari-bharia jamaʼana miana Israel, "Siimo giu iparintaakana KAWASANA OPU,
Bhawamo pasombaa hususu minaaka i pewauamu to KAWASANA OPU. Incema morelana totona incana tabeana abhawa pasombaa hususu to Aulataʼala, siitumo bulawa, pera tee tambaga,
kambari waranaa kakanda, wungu, tee maleʼi matuʼa, kae lenan alusu, buluna bhembe,
kulina dumba umane motowaranaai maleʼi, kulina lumba-lumba, kau akasia,
mina to kainawa, rampa-rampa to mina idhupai tee dhupa mawondu,
tee bhatu tundu krisopras tee manga tundu mototalana i bhaju efod tee katutubhina bada."
"Bhari-bharia mia moʼahalii i tanga-tangamiu tabeana aumba to akarajaaka bhari-bharia iparintaakana KAWASANA OPU:

content.text: Kema Momangkilo, kema tee katutubhina, manga kakaina, manga toorana, manga kau leleana, manga ariina bhamba tee manga kalempesina;
Soronga Pojanjia tee rua pale kancodhaana, katutubhina sorongana to ahapusuaka dosa, tee corocoro katutubhina;
meja tee rua pale kancodhaana, bhari-bharia parakakasina, tee roti pasombaa;
padamara to kainawa tee parakakasina, suluna, tee mina to kainawa;
tampa tunuana dhupa tee rua pale kancodhaana, mina idhupai tee dhupa mawondu;
tampana tunuana kurubani tee jala-jala tambagana, rua pale kancodhaana tee bhari-bharia parakakasina,
manga corocoro to abulilingiaka tanalapa i saripina Kema Momangkilo, manga ariina, manga kalempesina, tee corocorona bhambana lawana tanalapa;
manga patona Kema Momangkilo tee patona tanalapa tee manga rabutana;
pakea moʼalusu itanu to apadhaangiaaka ibaadati i tampa momangkilo, pakea momangkilo to imamu Harun, tee pakeana manga anana to akarajaaka tugasina amembali imamu."

content: Kasiimpo, alingkamo bhari-bharia jamaʼana miana Israel minaaka i aroana Musa.

Sapadhana incia sumai, aumbamo bhari-bharia mia mopeeluna tee morelana totona incana abhawa pasombaa hususu i KAWASANA OPU to akarajaa Kema Pokawaana tee Aulataʼala, to saangua ibaadatina, tee pakea momangkilo.

Bhari-bharia morelana totona incana malape umane atawa bhawine aumba abhawa dhali-dhalina ango, dhali-dhalina talinga, singkaru, tee simbina limana, sagala giu bulawa to pasombaa hususu isusuakana i KAWASANA OPU.
Tee uka sumai, bhari-bharia mia mokokambarina waranaa kakanda, wungu, tee maleʼi matuʼa, lenan alusu, buluna bhembe, kulina dumba umane motowaranaai maleʼi, tee kulina lumba-lumba, aumba abhawea.
Bhari-bharia mia mopasombaakana pasombaa hususu minaaka i pera atawa o tambaga abhawea i KAWASANA OPU, tee bhari-bharia mia mokokauna akasia aumba uka abhawea to akarajaaka manga bara ibaadati,
Bhari-bharia bhawine moʼahaliina mountena kambari tee limana karona, aumba abhawa bara iuntena, siitumo kambari waranaa kakanda, wungu, tee maleʼi matuʼa, tee lenan alusu.
Manga incia arela totona incana aunte kambari minaaka i buluna bhembe.
Manga kapala abhawa bhatu tundu krisopras tee manga tundu mototalana i bhaju efod tee katutubhina bada,
manga rampa tee mina to kainawa, to mina idhupai tee dhupa mawondu.

Bhari-bharia umane tee bhawine morelana totona incana abhawa opeopeapo uka to bhari-bharia karajaa iparintaakana KAWASANA OPU alaloi Musa. Miana Israel aumba abhawea bhari-bharia to pasombaa kadhawu i KAWASANA OPU.
Angkaana Bezaleel tee Aholiab
Musa apogau i miana Israel, "Kamatea, KAWASANA OPU padhamo akemba Bezaleel bin Uri bin Hur, minaaka i lipu Yuda.
KAWASANA OPU padhamo adhawu Rohina Aulataʼala i Bezaleel tee adhawua hikimati, kakidha, tee ilimuu.
Mamudhaakana incia amembali akarajaa pegiu-giu modele minaaka i bulawa, pera, tee tambaga,
kabhelokina bhatu tundu to atalea, tee abhelokiakea kau, mamudhaakana incia amembali akarajaaia bhari-bharia ihaejatiakana sumai.
I nuncana ngangarandana, Aulataʼala padhamo arahumatiakea kakidha to aadhariaka manga mia mosagaanana, mboo sumai uka i nuncana ngangarandana Aholiab bin Ahisamakh minaaka i lipu Dan.

KAWASANA OPU uka abarakati manga mia incia sumai tee hikimati to akarajaa bhari-bharia karajaana pande, karajaana moʼahaliina, karajaana mosokaina kambari waranaa kakanda, wungu, tee maleʼi matuʼa, tee kae lenan alusu, tee karajaana pande tanu. Jadi, manga incia satotuuna mokarajaana bhari-bharia giuna ikarajaa.
